purpose: Find a testable BTC/ETH return forecast after costs; no promise of profits and no automatic real-money promotion
source: Kraken Futures trade PF_XBTUSD/PF_ETHUSD completed 1h candles and official historical hourly funding

model.target: gross endpoint return in basis points, one independent model per asset
model.standardization: training-only mean and population standard deviation, floor 0.1
features: relative own-minus-peer 24h return normalized by combined volatility
model.volatility: 168 completed hourly log returns; no contemporaneous quote interpolation
model.refit: Train on 2024 for development; after selecting one candidate refit on 2024-2025 and freeze weights for final 2026 test

execution.signal: Required hourly candles must already be complete; next strictly later hourly open entry
execution.exit: Fixed horizon after actual entry, no candle stop/target assumptions
execution.positions: One shared BTC/ETH slot; highest expected net return wins; BTC tie break
execution.funding: Explicit adverse-funding SCENARIO every holding hour on open mark notional, charged for both long and short: base uses 95th percentile absolute hourly training funding, stress uses 99th percentile plus the separate 1bp/24h stress reserve; actual incomplete rows remain available but are not called verified cashflows
execution.forecastFundingReserve: 95th percentile absolute hourly training funding rate * holding hours; computed before evaluation period
execution.entryHurdle: Absolute predicted gross return minus 13 bps base round-trip friction minus forecast funding reserve must be strictly above 5 bps
execution.stressEligibility: Same prequalified forecasts under base and stress; stress does not filter expensive losing signals retrospectively
execution.zeroVolumeAndMissingData: No forced executable fills: present zero-volume entry resolves as a known nonfill at that bar's CLOSE, retaining the slot until then; zero-volume exit or missing selected price/mark remains unresolved and invalidates full-period profit. Present zero-volume OHLC may supply an explicitly stale indicative mark, never an execution. Adverse funding scenario does not invent actual funding observations.
execution.endBoundary: No position may cross evaluation endpoint; reserve at least 26h before endpoint for all candidate signals

selection.objective: 2025 stress net PnL USD minus 0.5 * stress maximum mark-to-market drawdown USD
selection.developmentGateBeforeOpeningFinalTest: Selected candidate must have positive base and stress net PnL, at least 100 trades and 20 trades per asset, and no selected unknown outcome; otherwise stop with 2026 final test unopened
selection.baselineReference: Select strongest of fixed 24h-held 168h-trend, BTC buy-and-hold, ETH buy-and-hold by same 2025 utility; also report flat and every baseline
selection.postTestModelChanges: Any change is a new candidate and cannot reuse this final test as untouched evidence

paperTrialAcceptance.baseNetPnl: strictly positive overall and each claimed asset
paperTrialAcceptance.stressNetPnl: nonnegative overall and each claimed asset
paperTrialAcceptance.mustBeat: Flat and development-selected simple baseline in final base and stress PnL
paperTrialAcceptance.predictiveAdvantage: Report full-origin gross MSE versus zero and training unconditional forecasts; do not claim model advantage if no improvement
paperTrialAcceptance.statisticalEvidence: Report one-sided 95% lower bound on full-calendar daily PnL improvement using shared 7-day moving blocks, 2000 resamples and fixed seed 20260908
paperTrialAcceptance.strongerValidation: Positive lower bounds against flat and selected baseline, then at least 30 forward paper days and 50 reconciled fills INCLUDING ACTUAL FUNDING under unchanged rule; no automatic live promotion

amendmentsBeforeAnyModelFitOrReturnInspe.reason: Official funding export ends February 1, 2026, has older hourly gaps, and source timestamp convention is unverified. Analytics OHLC rates are not verified settlement cashflows.
amendmentsBeforeAnyModelFitOrReturnInspe.change: Retain original train/development/test dates; use disclosed training-calibrated adverse funding scenarios, not unverifiable actual historical funding. Positive results only nominate an operational paper candidate, not verified historical profitability. No funding reserve is calibrated from final-test data.

amendmentsBeforeAnyModelFitOrReturnInspe.reason: Existing horizon study already inspected August 27, 2026. Exclude the entire August month to avoid calling reused prices untouched. No model returns have been inspected.
amendmentsBeforeAnyModelFitOrReturnInspe.change: Final test ends August 1 exclusive: January through July, seven full calendar months. August data remains downloaded but is excluded from all evaluation and fitting.

knownLimitations: Hourly OHLCV cannot prove order-book fillability or intrahour path
Funding scenario percentiles are assumptions, not guaranteed upper bounds on future funding; exact after-cost profitability is not established
Synthetic small-notional fills require paper execution reconciliation and tick/lot validation before activation
Longer holding periods can have losses larger than historical samples; a $12 order cap is not a $12 risk allowance
